name: MV Power
old_description: MV POWER is an Engineering Services Company designated to be your Engineering “on demand” Department. Our Team is standing by for your enquiry, whether it is via phone, email or “snail-mail”. We enjoy speaking with our Customers!
about:
MV Power LLC operates from Erie, Pennsylvania, providing engineering services with a focus on medium voltage switchgear retrofill. The company positions itself as an on-demand engineering department for clients, though no founding year, ownership structure, or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The firm delivers engineering support for medium voltage switchgear retrofill projects, offering design, analysis, and project management services. It operates as a service-oriented organization rather than a product manufacturer, with no disclosed facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

MV Power serves customers in the electrical power sector who require retrofitting of existing medium voltage switchgear, though specific industry verticals or named clients are not disclosed in public materials.

The company emphasizes its role as an "Engineering 'on demand' Department," standing ready to respond to inquiries via phone, email, or mail, aiming to provide flexible engineering capacity without the overhead of a full-time staff.
built_on: Direct customer access via phone, email, or mail
